positive_snippets: The hotel location is strategic. It is close to the airport. If you have a morning flight, this hotel should be your option. The staff is good. The room is big. But, the light inside the room is dim. The heater did not work optimally. The bed is soft, clean and out of date.

Not worth the price we paid.

Pros:
✔️ The person at the reception was cooperative.

Cons:
❌ Rooms are extremely noisy—you can hear outside noise, even footsteps.
❌ The rooms were small and had an unpleasant smell.
❌ They didn’t provide room keys, so every time we went out, we had to ask the reception to open the room.
❌ Very few restaurants nearby, making it difficult to find good dining options.

Overall, a disappointing experience. Would not recommend.

We had booked a suite for four people, in what we  believed to be a four star hotel. When we arrived in the early evening we realized that our room was dirty with dust, Several issues made my stay uncomfortable:

DO NOT STAY WITH FAMILY NOT RECOMENDED

Toilet Flush Issues: The toilet flush didn’t work properly throughout my stay, which was incredibly frustrating and unhygienic.

Hand Shower Problems: The hand shower was either broken or malfunctioning, making it difficult to use. It was an inconvenience that could have been easily avoided with proper maintenance.

Lack of Cleanliness: The overall cleanliness of the room left much to be desired. The bathroom and floors didn’t seem like they had been thoroughly cleaned, and there were unpleasant odors throughout the space.

Unpleasant Atmosphere: There were drunk and noisy people in the hotel late at night, making it hard to relax or get a good night's sleep. The management didn’t seem to address this issue, which greatly affected the atmosphere.

No Hot Shower: To top it off, there was no hot water in the shower, which was extremely disappointing, especially after a long day of travel. Every day i have to request for hot water

Overall, the experience was quite negative, and I would not recommend this hotel. Basic amenities.
